help.about_text: A step in issuing a new identity is to verify that you are you :) This is done with ID-porten, where students can use MinID and employees can use BankID.
help.steps_list: SMS for activation -> Verification with ID-porten -> Create account with password and 2-step -> Ready to use
help.contact_student: Contact your ICT service at your school if you are a student.

mockidporten.title: MOCK IDPORTEN
mockidporten.button: Pretend to log in with ID-porten
mockidporten.info: No data will be fetched/sent, this only happens locally in your browser

success.account_ready: Your account is now ready to use
success.account_security_tip: Tip: Later you can visit myaccount.microsoft.com to add sign-in methods.

dialog_reset_mfa.title: Reset MFA methods
dialog_reset_mfa.body: This will remove all your current MFA methods (authenticator app registrations, phone factors, FIDO keys, etc.) so you can reconfigure them. Continue?

dialog_setup_mfa.title: Set up MFA methods
dialog_setup_mfa.body: You need to configure multi-factor authentication (MFA) to complete the account setup. This includes setting up authenticator apps, phone factors, or other security methods. Continue?

dialog_mfa_info.title: Existing Account - MFA Setup Required
dialog_mfa_info.body: You have an existing account and we need to set up multi-factor authentication (MFA). We will need you to log in with your account using fresh credentials to proceed with MFA configuration.

dialog_mfa_confirm.title: Confirm MFA Method Deletion
dialog_mfa_confirm.body: We are about to delete your existing MFA methods (authenticator app registrations, phone factors, FIDO keys, etc.) so you can set up new ones. This action cannot be undone.

dialog_mfa_success.title: MFA Methods Removed Successfully
dialog_mfa_success.body: Your existing MFA methods have been successfully removed.
dialog_mfa_success.reminder_body: Please remember to delete the old entries from your Microsoft Authenticator app and any other authentication apps or devices you were using.
dialog_mfa_success.next: We will now redirect you to set up your new MFA methods with fresh credentials.

dialog_password_success.title: Password Set Successfully!
dialog_password_success.message: Your password has been successfully set and saved!
dialog_password_success.next_step: Next, you will be redirected to set up multi-factor authentication (MFA):
dialog_password_success.next_step_short: You will now be redirected to set up MFA (multi-factor authentication)
dialog_password_success.step1: Log in with your username and the password you just created
dialog_password_success.step2: Set up Microsoft Authenticator or another MFA method

dialog_phone.body_send:
We got this number {phone} from KRR.
We will use this number.

If wrong number, change the number at Kontakt- og Reservasjons-registeret (KRR) with the "Change number". Retry from the beginning after the update.
dialog_phone.body_enter: Enter the new mobile number including country code (example: +4790012345).
dialog_phone.body_validate: Enter the 6-digit code sent by SMS to validate your new number.
dialog_phone.krr_update_notice: We are updating the Kontakt- og Reservasjons-registeret with this new number.
dialog_phone.code_sent_hint: Resend code if you dont get it after 3 minutes.

verifyuser.dialog_phone_confirm_body:
We got this from KRR:

{phone}

If wrong number.
Change your information at Kontakt- og Reservasjons-Registeret (KRR). After the change, you must start over again so we can get the new number.
verifyuser.sms_creating_message:
We are going to create a temporary password and send it to you.

{phone}
verifyuser.no_phone_available: No phone number available. Please change your phone number to continue.
verifyuser.sms_sending_redirect:
Generating password and sending it to you.
Redirecting you to your account...
verifyuser.sending_code_wait: Sending a 6-digit code to the new number...
verifyuser.mfa_reset_success_message: Your MFA methods have been removed from your account. Continue to setup new method.
verifyuser.mfa_pre_delete_message: Next step will delete the methods available
verifyuser.mfa_pre_delete_notice: When you press Continue the deletion starts.
verifyuser.mfa_post_delete_message: All methods deleted. Remember to also delete your account from Microsoft Authenticator app to prevent conflicts. Continue to set up new ones.
verifyuser.mfa_reset_incomplete_message: Some MFA methods could not be deleted automatically.
verifyuser.mfa_reset_admin_message: Some methods require administrator permissions to delete. Please contact your IT administrator.
verifyuser.mfa_reset_partial_success: Deleted {removed} of {total} MFA methods. {remaining} methods remain.
verifyuser.mfa_continue_disabled: Continue button is disabled until all methods are removed.
verifyuser.mfa_max_retries_reached: Attempted {count} times. Please contact helpdesk for assistance.
verifyuser.mfa_fresh_auth_required: Note: You will be redirected to start the MFA reset process again.
verifyuser.cancelled_message: Ok. Retry when you are ready. You can close this window.

dialog_send_password.title: Send temporary password
dialog_send_password.body: We will now send a temporary password by SMS to {phone}.

verifyuser.phone_missing_explanation:
We did not find any number at Kontakt- og Reservasjons-registeret (KRR).

Please update at KRR, use the "Update source" to get to the page.

After updating your phone - start over again.
